column1: #   cat videos online: Who watches Internet cats
# Design: online Qualtrics survey (snowball sample recruited via Facebook/Twitter and
#   Lil BUB's social channels) of Internet users who view cat videos/photos online;
#   age 38.74 (SD = 14.07). Retrospective paired measures: respondents rated 24
#   discrete emotions on a 1 ("not at all") to 7 ("very much") scale recalling how
#   they felt BEFORE and AFTER their most recent online cat video/photo viewing.
# Lock5 3e ships no dataset for this question (checked lock5stat.com/datapage3e.html)
# so this file reconstructs the published AGGREGATE summary statistics from paper
# Table 2 (p. 172). These are NOT raw respondent records. Columns:
#   variable                  short key used by the analysis script
#   items                     adjective items averaged into the scale

column2: sd_prior      pre-viewing mean and SD (1-7 scale)
